description: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the composition of the MULTITURNINSTRUCT benchmark dataset, which contains approximately 1.1K samples distributed across three levels of difficulty and nine distinct capability categories. The chart is divided into nine colored slices, each representing one of the capabilities: “Retrieval,” “Reasoning,” “Multitasking,” “Contextual Understanding,” “Instruction Following,” “Conflict Resolution,” “Personalization,” “Privacy Protection,” and “Dynamic Adaptation.” Each slice is labeled with its corresponding capability name and the exact number of samples it contains, visually indicating a balanced distribution across capabilities as stated in the caption. The slices are arranged in a circular layout with no exploded segments, and the colors are distinct enough to differentiate each category. A legend is not present within the figure itself, as labels are directly placed on or adjacent to each slice. The overall visual design emphasizes the structured, multi-dimensional nature of the benchmark, highlighting its focus on evaluating LLMs across diverse and balanced multi-turn instruction-following tasks.
